test_title: SSC CGL Tier 2 Quant Previous Year Paper (Held On: 29 Jan 2022)
subject: general
question: A sum of money becomes Rs. 11,880 after 4 years and Rs. 17,820 after 6 years on compound interest, if the interest is compounded annually. What is the half of the sum (in Rs.)?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

In Compound Interest, the amounts at equal time intervals follow a constant multiplier (GP).

Multiplier for 2 years (6 − 4) = 17,820 ÷ 11,880 = 1.5

Since 4 years = 2 years × 2, the multiplier for 4 years is (1.5)² = 2.25

Principal (P) = Amount after 4 years ÷ 2.25 = 11,880 ÷ 2.25 = ₹5,280

Required value = Half of P = 5,280 ÷ 2 = ₹2,640

**∴ The correct answer is ₹2640.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

Given: Amount after 4 years (A₄) = ₹11,880 and Amount after 6 years (A₆) = ₹17,820

Formula used: A = P(1 + r/100)ⁿ

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/b3435e6a393b453aa49a85390414da71a5ffc561afd9b33ff8e0b8adf38e6afc.png] 

⇒ A₄ = P(1 + r/100)⁴ = 11,880 --- (1)

⇒ A₆ = P(1 + r/100)⁶ = 17,820 --- (2)

⇒ Dividing (2) by (1): (1 + r/100)⁶−⁴ = 17,820 ÷ 11,880

⇒ (1 + r/100)² = 1.5

⇒ Substituting (1 + r/100)² in equation (1):

⇒ P × [(1 + r/100)²]² = 11,880

⇒ P × (1.5)² = 11,880

⇒ P × 2.25 = 11,880

⇒ P = 11,880 ÷ 2.25 = 11,880 ÷ (9/4)

⇒ P = (11,880 × 4) ÷ 9 = 1,320 × 4 = ₹5,280

⇒ Required value = P ÷ 2 = 5,280 ÷ 2 = ₹2,640

**∴ The correct answer is ₹2640.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Compound Interest GP Property

In compound interest, the amounts at regular time intervals (t, 2t, 3t...) always form a Geometric Progression (GP) where the common ratio is (1 + r/100)t.

Effective Rate for Compounding

If interest is compounded half-yearly, the effective rate for a year becomes rₑff = r + r + (r×r)/100, where the period rate is half of the annual rate.

CI and SI Difference

For 2 years, the difference between CI and SI on a principal P at rate r% is given by Diff = P(r/100)².
